I fixed the pipeline in the three writable files. No tests were run (no executor available); changes were verified by reading the code against the spec.

**`src/merge.mjs`** — rewrote `mergeLayers`:
- No longer mutates `DEFAULTS` (`Object.assign(defaults, ...)` was the cross-call state leak).
- Deep-merges `network` and `ui` immediate fields so a partial override keeps siblings.
- Copies only the documented fields (`endpoint`, `retries`, `theme`, `compact`, `enabled`) into fresh objects, so no nested references to defaults/file/env are retained.
- Uses own-property checks, so falsy values (`0`, `false`) are preserved rather than skipped.

**`src/env-config.mjs`** — rewrote `readEnvLayer`:
- Recognized keys are honored when present (own property, not `undefined`), so `APP_RETRIES=0`/`APP_ENABLED=false` are no longer dropped by truthiness checks.
- `APP_RETRIES` must match `^[0-9]+$` (leading zeros allowed) and parse to a safe integer ≤ `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; otherwise `TypeError`.
- `APP_COMPACT`/`APP_ENABLED` must be exactly `"true"`/`"false"`; otherwise `TypeError`.
- Missing keys have no effect; other keys ignored; invalid layer objects still throw `TypeError`.

**`src/validate.mjs`** — tightened `retries` to `Number.isSafeInteger` (plus range check) and returns a fresh deep-copied object so results never alias inputs or defaults.

`src/index.mjs`, `formatLegacy`, `formatConfig`, defaults, precedence, and the exported API are unchanged.
